_comment: Real GA (Address) table and Association table MemExtWrite ops captured via tshark during a genuine ETS Full Download to 1.1.9, AFTER real project GAs were renumbered to non-degenerate values (main/middle both non-zero) specifically to settle Finding 3 of docs/follow-ups/2026-08-27-relmem-write-scope-investigation.md. Source: ga_wire_format_test.pcapng, frames 229/230 (Address table) and 219/220 (Association table).

gaTable.note: Real ETS group-address tree confirms these are correct: 9/1/1 and 9/1/4 under '9 System > 9/1 Astro'. Count field is 2 bytes, GA value is the raw 16-bit main/middle/sub encoding, no reordering.

associationTable.note: Byte-identical to the earlier degenerate-GA capture (same device, old 0/0/1 and 0/0/4 GAs) - expected and confirms the format: association entries reference the GA table by 1-based POSITION, not by raw GA value, so renumbering the same two GA slots produces identical association bytes.
